subject: Mutual Action Plan: Legal redlines ownership & turnaround checklist
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Grant <sophie@finexa.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-05T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Post-call recap + MAP (legal redlines owners + TAT)

Sophie — thanks again for a productive discovery call this morning. Attached is the current MAP (Finexa_MAP_v1.xlsx) with milestones we discussed. I wanted to call out the legal redlines milestone and propose a clear ownership and turnaround plan so we don’t block the target close.

Quick summary and asks:
- Target close date: 2027-12-10 (mutual).
- Legal redlines milestone (MSA / DPA / SLA):
  • Primary owner (Redwood legal): Monica Patel — responsible for redline pass and commentary.
  • Sales owner (internal coordinator): Ben Carter — will track changes, maintain consolidated file, and escalate commercial points.
  • Escalation lead (pricing/terms exceptions): Marissa Cole (legal exec) — only if material commercial concessions required.
- Suggested turnaround: initial commercial-first pass within 48 hours of receiving the customer’s consolidated comments; full legal review for technical/regulatory clauses within 5 business days.
- Dependencies: procurement consolidation of redlines from Finexa (procurement@finexa.com), SOC2 evidence request (see MAP row 4), and any DPA data residency notes.

Next steps:
1) Sophie — please share the consolidated redline file or single-source of truth.
2) Finexa procurement — confirm expected date for consolidated redlines (we flagged 5 business days on the call).
3) Monica — we'll hand the attached MSA_DPA_SLA_Redlines_v0.1.docx to legal for the first triage pass once Sophie confirms.

Attachments: Finexa_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP), MSA_DPA_SLA_Redlines_v0.1.docx (blank redline template).

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a short tracker update once we have the consolidated redline.

– Naomi

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-05T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP (legal redlines owners + TAT)

Thanks Naomi — got it and thanks for the clear owners. A few quick legal notes so expectations are aligned before we accept a 48h TAT for everything:

1) Triage approach (recommended):
   - Commercial redlines (pricing, SOW, termination, indemnity caps) — we should aim for a 48-hour initial pass so sales can continue negotiation.
   - Technical/regulatory clauses (DPA, data residency, security exhibits, SLA credits) — these often require product/security and may need 3–5 business days for a substantive redline and internal sign-off.

2) Ownership split suggestion:
   - MSA (commercial terms): Monica lead, Ben support for commercial rationale.
   - DPA (data handling, residency): Monica lead, loop in Security (Marissa) for approvals on exhibits.
   - SLA (uptime/credits): Monica + Platform Reliability SME (I will request a brief run from Marissa).

3) Escalation: if Finexa requests changes that materially change Redwood’s standard exposure (e.g., broader indemnities or unlimited liability), we will escalate to Marissa immediately.

4) Deliverable names: when the customer shares edits please ask them to return a single consolidated redline (track changes) named: Finexa_Redlines_Consolidated_YYYYMMDD.docx. We will produce our first pass with in-line comments.

I can commit to: commercial-pass in ~48 hours of receiving a consolidated file; full legal plus security review in up to 5 business days depending on complexity. If procurement confirms a 5-business-day turnaround on their side, that syncs well with our timeline.

Monica Patel
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

Attachment: guidance_redline_priority_checklist.pdf (inline checklist)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Agree with Monica's triage — Naomi, I'll own consolidation and the public tracker. Practical asks from sales ops perspective:
- Please ask Finexa to return ONE consolidated file (not multiple threads).
- If they intend to redline across DocuSign/other channels, ask procurement to export a single .docx with track changes.
- I'll prepare a simple column in the MAP to record: Clause, Request, Redwood Position, Owner, ETA.

I'll mark commercial items for an expedited 48h response. Anything flagged as "legal-sensitive" will be routed to Monica/Marissa and I will note expected 3–5 business day TAT in the tracker.

— Ben
